raw_text: member_002 (独立复核) is ready. Please publish your fixed candidate via fix_patch and send handoff_patch with the patch_id when ready. I will integrate, run the public sympy tests (sympy/simplify/tests/test_sqrtdenest.py focused) on the exact candidate version, then accept or request changes. Note: the required behavior is that non-denestable input such as (3 - sqrt(2)*sqrt(4+3*I) + 3*I)/2 is returned unchanged rather than raising IndexError from _split_gcd in sympy/simplify/radsimp.py.
